billed.description: Billed by the supplier in the year, less vendor credits, in the base currency, GST included; absent when you do not view bills.

invoiced.description: Invoiced to the customer in the year, less credit notes, in the base currency, GST included; absent when you do not view invoices.

payable.description: What the company owes the supplier, by currency and days past due, with its unapplied credits; empty when nothing is open, or when you do not view bills.

receivable.description: What the customer owes the company, by currency and days past due, with its unapplied credits; empty when nothing is open, or when you do not view invoices.

timeline.description: Their latest documents you may see, newest first: at most 50.

year.description: The financial year holding the day; absent when the years are not set.
